analysis: Windows-only file-locking race when the pipeline 'destroy' step tries to delete a workspace directory that is still held open by another process/handle. The PR only changed a dashboard Razor component and its test file, unrelated to the pipeline execution code, so this failure is not connected to the PR's changes.
